profile.headline: ETL/BI QA Analyst
profile.summary:
•	13 years of IT experience in Software Development, Support, Maintenance and Testing activities.
•	Exposure in Data Ware House (ETL) Testing.
•	Exposure in Report testing (Cognos/MicroStrategy)
•	Exposure in Test Planning, Test Scripting and Test Execution and Defect management.
•	Exposure in developing End to End ( Source to Target ) test plan for a Data warehouse platform 
•	Exposure in developing complex SQL queries in Teradata and Vertica Database to ensure quality of data in Warehouse.
•	Experience in Data mining and Data analysis from the Data Warehouse systems. 
•	Exposure in developing Test Automation scripts to reduce test execution turnaround time. 
•	Strong Technical Expertise in technologies like Oracle, SQL, PL/SQL. 
•	Exposure to tools like HP Quality Center , Jira, DBeaver 
•	Exposure to Waterfall and Agile methodology.
•	Domain knowledge of Annuities and Life Insurance, Knowledge of CIS system in Utility Domain
•	Extensively worked on creation of SQL queries as part of Adhoc Report generation for business users.
